summary: Hecla Mining filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new $500 million senior secured revolving credit facility on September 16, 2026, with Hecla Limited and subsidiary borrowers, Bank of America as administrative agent, and a lender group. The facility matures September 16, 2030, with a one-year extension option and an accordion of up to $100 million. It replaces the Existing Credit Agreement, is priced off Term SOFR or base rate plus a margin, and carries interest-coverage and net-leverage covenants. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation.
